literal: What will physical confinement guarding do? For women, the guard of guarding self-restraint indeed is foremost.
translation: Of what use is physical confinement to guard women? The self-restraint with which they guard themselves is the foremost protection.
modern: பெண்களைச் சிறைவைத்துத் தடுக்கும் காவல் என்ன பயனைச் செய்யும்? அவர்கள் தங்களது நிறை என்னும் சுயக்கட்டுப்பாட்டால் தங்களைக் காத்துக் கொள்ளும் காவலே முதன்மையானது.
explanation: This couplet contrasts external physical restraint with internal moral strength. The poet asks what benefit can possibly come from locking women up or guarding them physically. Instead, the self-restraint and moral integrity, referred to as 'niṟai', which women possess to guard themselves, is declared to be the ultimate and most effective protection. True virtue cannot be forced from the outside; it must come from within.
